description: WindPredict models the solar wind with heating and acceleration associated with Alfvén waves. Its MHD formulation supports reconstruction of heliospheric conditions from solar boundary information. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The page does not establish present executable distribution; model settings govern physical coverage and resolution. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue.
